reasoning_content:
Candidates with sites:
- tartarusai.dev
- molochai.dev
- uplinkswitch.ai
- closedhand.com
- routerhub.si

Let me probe each for free credits/API price/signup requirements. Look for "free", "credit", "$", "sign up", "api key".

Let me fetch homepages + /pricing if exists.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 400 python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,re,html
sites=["https://tartarusai.dev","https://molochai.dev","https://uplinkswitch.ai","https://closedhand.com","https://routerhub.si"]
for u in sites:
    try:
        r=urllib.request.Request(u,headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) Chrome/131.0"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=25) as x: s=x.read().decode(errors="ignore"); code=x.status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: s=e.read().decode(errors="ignore"); code=e.code
    except Exception as e: print(f"{u:28} ERR {type(e).__name__}"); continue
    t=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); t=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',t,flags=re.S)
    t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t)); t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t).strip()
    kw=[k for k in ["free","credit","trial","no credit card","sign up","api key","$"] if k in t.lower()]
    print(f"\n### {u} [{code}] kata: {','.join(kw)}")
    print("   ",t[:260])
PY
